The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973(in short, 'Code'),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.
2. The petitioners are apprehending arrest by the Ambalavayal Police, Wayanad District, for allegedly committing an offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard; Sri. O.D. Sivadas, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt.Seetha S., the learned Senior Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.
4.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that as on today there is no case registered against the petitioners by the said police, as alleged in the bail application.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is closed.

It is made clear that, if the presence of the petitioners are required by Ambalavayal police with regard to the allegations made in the bail application, they shall be issued with a notice under Section 41A of the Code, if the offence alleged against them is punishable for less than seven years.

SD/-
